description:
Use this when you need Japan statutory national-holiday status for 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a company, school, bank, exchange or prefectural closure calendar.
What it computes: Checks a date against Japan's statutory national holidays and Saturday/Sunday baseline.
Example user requests: Is 2027-03-22 a Japan working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-03-22"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_legal_bases, weekend_days, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Japan weekday baseline and no Cabinet Office statutory holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/japan-national-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/japan-national-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned Cabinet Office 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_japan_national_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or statutory national holiday.

holiday_kinds.description: National holiday or statutory holiday under the Cabinet Office table.

holiday_legal_bases.description: Holiday Act or Cabinet Office legal classification.

holiday_names.description: Japanese statutory holiday names applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: True when the Japan Saturday/Sunday baseline is a weekday and no statutory national holiday applies.

rest_day_policy.description: Company, school, bank and exchange closures are not inferred.

sources.description: Official Cabinet Office and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Japan National Holiday Working Day
